jobs.expression: 相手の頼みを聞く、応えたいが即答できない
jobs.pose: 腰掛け、閉じた帳面に片手を置き、もう片方を小さく開く
jobs.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: ONE expressive character illustration for the original game "Ash Estuary", meant for a dialogue vignette or character scene rather than a neutral costume reference.
Inputs: Image 1 is STYLE B (delicate irregular pen contours, restrained hatching, pale watercolor, warm ivory paper, muted coastal colors). Image 2 is the existing character's IDENTITY AND COSTUME reference. Keep the EXACT same person: face structure, age appearance, skin, hair, body build, clothes, repairs and palette. Change the camera, pose, gesture and expression as specified below. The old full-body pose and rightward gaze are NOT composition constraints.
Art: quiet observed life, capable working people, realistic proportions but plainly drawn and painted rather than photography. A restrained readable facial expression with a specific motive; no stock hero stance, glamour, shouting or caricature. Hands anatomically plausible, gestures legible. Work props obey weight and grip.
Backdrop: mostly clean warm ivory paper with at most a few lightly washed local work surfaces directly supporting the pose. No elaborate scenic background, another person, decorative props, panels, turnarounds, expression collage, titles, readable text, symbols, watermark or framing border. Both face and expressive hands must be clearly legible, even at smaller display size.
World: ordinary preindustrial coastal work. No magical light, armor, weapons, ghosts, illustrated memories, remembered family members, bodily corrosion, outcomes of player decisions or hidden truths. Records are closed or have indistinct pen marks only. Do not use lighting or expression to declare someone morally right or villainous.
Pose, camera and expression:
Ira. Landscape about 3:2. Waist-up seated behind the very edge of a plain weathered wooden work desk, viewed obliquely FROM HER LEFT with a slightly elevated eye line, not the standing three-quarter silhouette from the reference. She leans forward slightly to listen to someone off frame on image LEFT. One hand rests gently on a CLOSED thin battered allocation ledger; the other opens modestly, palm oblique toward the listener, fingers naturally relaxed. Face turned toward that listener, eyebrows subtly raised in attention, eyes compassionate but thoughtful, mouth slightly parted as though about to answer and hesitating. The motive is wanting to respond responsibly with limited means. Keep her dark bob, moss shoulder cloth and long slate-blue coat recognizable. Include face, both hands, shoulders and desk edge inside a clean ivory-paper composition; leave a little quiet space in the direction she is looking. No labels or readable ledger.
